summary: First full E2E test of ICF Operations Hub. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passing (auth login/logout/register/me, bracing calc with expected 664.3 psf / 12 braces / 3.8 ft spacing, estimator BOM, equipment CRUD, customer create, rental create+return with availability decrement/restore, maintenance, dashboard stats). Frontend: login flow works with seeded admin creds, dashboard renders stats + inventory pie chart, bracing engine submits and shows results with pressure profile chart, estimator generates BOM table, equipment/rentals/calendar/maintenance pages all load with required data-testid hooks, logout redirects to /login. CORS + httpOnly cookies working with axios withCredentials.

minor.issue: Spec says admin-only but require_role('admin','foreman') also lets foremen delete. Verify intent.
Sets locked_until on EVERY failed attempt (not just at threshold), so lockout extends even on attempts 1-4. Functional but unusual behavior.

action_items: Optional: Confirm DELETE /api/equipment role policy (currently admin OR foreman, problem statement says admin-only).
Optional: Consider only setting lockout window when failed >= MAX_FAILED, not on every failure.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 830 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, bracing, estimator, equipment, rentals, maintenance, dashboard) for maintainability.
JWT_SECRET / MONGO_URL / DB_NAME read via os.environ[...] which fails fast — good practice.
MongoDB ObjectId properly excluded via serializer functions — good.
Bracing/Estimator endpoints save history under db.calculations — good audit trail.
FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated in favor of lifespan handlers (will warn but still works).
Brute-force lockout uses ip:email — good, but locked_until is reset on every failure (extends lock window indefinitely). Minor.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 7 equipment items + 2 customers + admin & foreman users on startup. Tests also created TEST_ prefixed equipment/customers/rentals (rentals returned, equipment deleted; customers remain but prefixed for easy cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Bracing expected values: lateral_pressure_psf=664.3, brace_count=12, recommended_spacing_ft~=3.8 (allow 0.2 tolerance). Frontend data-testids: email-input, password-input, auth-submit-btn, bracing-calc-submit, estimator-submit, add-equipment-btn, eq-submit, add-customer-btn, new-rental-btn. App fully functional E2E.
